_comment: House style for the fictional firm Larkspur Vale Capital. In the course, Lesson 1 produces this file by reading the firm's existing client letter and factsheet; every value here is one a reader would check against those materials.

chart_palette._comment: Categorical order is fixed; validated for color-vision deficiency (adjacent-pair deltaE >= 8) with the dataviz validator on 2026-11-06. Brand primary and accent are too muted for chart marks, so the chart palette is a brighter set in the same family.
